<issue>Issue Title: Files are not being created
Description:
### Issue
after 0.53 I started to experience following problem. If during refactoring aider decides to create a file or if I explicitly ask it to create a file, it generates `SEARCH/REPLACE`  for new file, but then doesn't try to create a new file:
```
> /code i asked to move bucket config to a separate file
I apologize for the oversight. You're right, we need to move the bucket configuration to a
separate file. Let's make that change now.
First, let's create a new file for the bucket configuration:
terraform/renovate/bucket.tf
<<<<<<<SEARCH
=======
resource "aws_s3_bucket" "renovate-terraform" {
// omitted output
Tokens: 6.8k sent, 812 received. Cost: $0.03 message, $0.07 session.
Applied edit to terraform/renovate/role.tf
No changes made to git tracked files.
No changes made to git tracked files.
```
### Version and model info
Aider v0.54.4
Main model: claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620 with diff edit format, infinite output
Weak model: claude-3-haiku-20240307
Git repo: ../../.git with 250 files
Repo-map: using 1024 tokens, auto refresh
Added terraform/renovate/role.tf to the chat.
</issue>
